image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey rocky surface. The salamander displays characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, vivid yellow blotches and stripes along its back and tail. Its body is robust and cylindrical, with short, stout limbs visible. The head is broad, and the eyes are dark and protruding. The skin appears moist and glandular.
